name: number-ticker
title: Number ticker
description: Count up to a number when it scrolls into view. Shows the final value at once for reduced motion.

css.content:
/* Number ticker: digits keep a fixed width so the count never shifts the layout. */
.number-ticker { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

a11y: Screen readers get the final number from an sr-only copy; the animated frames are aria-hidden.
With prefers-reduced-motion the final number shows immediately and nothing animates.
